Private RPC client request and state structs with pollfd tracking.

# Purpose
This header defines private data structures for an RPC client implementation. It declares `struct fd_rpc_client_request`, which stores the state of one request, shared response storage, and state-specific fields for the connected and sent phases. It also declares `struct fd_rpc_client_private`, which keeps the client request ID, target address and port, poll file descriptors, and an array of request records sized by `FD_RPC_CLIENT_REQUEST_CNT`. The file includes `fd_rpc_client.h` for public client types and `poll.h` for `struct pollfd`, and it uses an include guard to prevent multiple inclusion.
